app.name: GoodLoop
app.subtitle: Your simple companion for healthy habits, movement and mindful balance.

auth.title: Welcome to GoodLoop
auth.subtitle: Start with one small goal and make it easier to keep going.
auth.successRegister: Signup requested. Check your email if Supabase confirmation is enabled.
auth.error: That did not work. Please check your details and try again.

onboarding.title: Small goals. Better balance.
onboarding.subtitle: Choose one first goal. One is enough to begin.
onboarding.chooseArea: What would you like to start with?

categories.balanceDescription: Cut back mindfully and choose with less pressure.

home.title: Today
home.subtitle: One small good choice is enough for today.
home.emptyTitle: Ready for one small good choice?
home.emptyText: Start with a simple goal for your day.
home.allDone: Strong day. You kept your balance today.
home.notAllDone: Small steps count. One completed goal is already a good start.
home.focusText: Up to three active goals are shown prominently, so your day stays clear.
home.tipText: Even one completed goal counts. This is about progress, not perfection.
home.microWinText: Checking one thing off today is enough. One small step in the right direction is exactly what GoodLoop is for.
home.reminderNudgeText: You can prepare a gentle reminder time in your profile.

goals.title: My goals
goals.subtitle: Choose a small goal or manage your active goals.
goals.noActive: No active goals yet. Start with one small goal for today.

progress.title: My progress
progress.subtitle: A calm look at what you have already done.
progress.empty: No progress visible yet. Start with one small goal and come back later.
progress.noCompleted: Nothing completed yet. Every start counts.
progress.weeklyReviewSubtitle: Your friendly look at the last few days.
progress.insightEmpty: Nothing yet. Start with one small goal and take the first step.
progress.insightStarted: You started. That is the point: not perfect, repeatable.
progress.insightSteady: You are building a rhythm. Small choices are slowly becoming routine.
progress.insightStrong: Strong week. You clearly stayed with it.
progress.insightBalanced: Nice mix: nutrition, movement and balance all show up. That is exactly the GoodLoop direction.
progress.milestonesSubtitle: Small markers that make progress visible.

profile.title: Profile
profile.visibilityText: Social is prepared, but stays voluntary and restrained.
profile.privateHelp: Only you can see your progress.
profile.friendsHelp: Later, friends can see selected achievements.
profile.pwaText: GoodLoop is prepared as a PWA. Your browser can later offer to save it to the home screen when supported.
profile.nextStepsText: Reminders, friends and shared milestones are prepared, but intentionally kept subtle.
profile.remindersText: Prepare a gentle reminder without adding pressure.
profile.reminderHelp: Push notifications are not active yet. This setting is saved now and will be used later.
profile.reminderComingSoon: Notifications will come later as a clean PWA step.
profile.shareMilestonesText: Prepare whether completed goals may later be shared voluntarily with friends.
profile.shareMilestonesEnabled: Allow selected milestones to be shared later

motivation.missedDay: One missed day doesn't reset your progress.

mock.title: Brand preview
mock.subtitle: GoodLoop feels bright, calm and motivating: small goals, clear cards and a soft Balance Loop as the brand mark.

social.title: Friends later
social.subtitle: GoodLoop stays private first. Later, you can voluntarily share selected achievements.
social.privateFirstText: No rankings, no pressure and no public failures.
social.shareLaterText: Milestones like “7 days completed” can later be shared with friends.

friends.title: Friends
friends.subtitle: Social stays intentionally small in GoodLoop: voluntary, private and without rankings.
friends.statusText: The database and interface are prepared. Real invitations and shared milestones will come later in a controlled way.
friends.privacyText: GoodLoop does not automatically show failures or daily progress.
friends.visibilityPrivate: Private: Only you can see your progress.
friends.visibilityFriends: Friends: Later, friends can see selected achievements.
friends.visibilityPublic: Public: Prepared for future public profiles.
friends.shareText: Later, achievements like “7 days completed” can be shared voluntarily. No rankings, no negative updates.
friends.shareOn: Prepared: Selected milestones may be shared later.
friends.nextOne: Find friends by email or profile
friends.nextThree: Share milestones consciously and receive small reactions
